entries.name: compileMarkdown
entries.signature: export declare function compileMarkdown(markdown: string, options?: CompileMarkdownOptions): Promise<CompiledMarkdown>;
entries.jsdocSummary: Compiles plain GitHub-flavoured markdown (not MDX: `<` and `{` in prose stay text) to HTML with this package's own plugins: GFM, GitHub-style heading ids, autolinked headings and code blocks highlighted by `rehype-pretty-code` (light and dark themes as `--shiki-light` / `--shiki-dark` CSS variables). Raw HTML in the markdown is sanitized (GitHub's rules: no `<script>`, no event handlers, no `javascript:` links) unless `trustedHtml` is set.

entries.name: CompileMarkdownOptions
entries.signature: export type CompileMarkdownOptions = { /** * Called with the `href` of every link. Return a new `href`, `null` to drop the link and keep its text, or * `undefined` to keep the link as written. */ rewriteLink?: (href: string) => string | null | undefined; /** * Keep raw HTML in the markdown exactly as written (scripts, event handlers and all). Default `false`: raw HTML is * parsed and then cleaned with `rehype-sanitize`'s GitHub-style rules, so a hostile document cannot inject script. * Set it only for markdown your own team wrote. */ trustedHtml?: boolean; };
